SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JANUARY 14, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.

Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Special Planning Commission Meeting
January 14, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Deputy City Manager/Acting Director of Community Development Ryan Carey
  Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Mary Balderrama

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Chauhan.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present, except Vice Chair
  Jhaveri, who was noted absent and excused by a majority consensus of the Planning
  Commission.

4.  Presentations

  Informational report providing a status update on water and sewer infrastructure,
  including an emergency repair of the C-4 well and purchase of imported water.

  A brief staff report was given by Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  and Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed, providing details about the City of Cerritos current water and sewer
  infrastructure needs, the emergency repair of the C-4 Well, and the approximate
  cost of imported water.

  Discussion continued with the Planning Commission regarding the cause of the C-4
  Well breach, the cost associated with repairs of the C-1 Well, the quality of water
  being imported, the projected start date of the C-4 Well repair, and the associated
  costs with waiting to make repairs.
City of Cerritos  January 14, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Cerritos resident Carla Gilhuys provided
  comments in opposition of the proposed water and sewer rate adjustments and her
  concerns regarding transparency and communication with Cerritos residents.

  Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, December 3, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chauhan, and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao, to approve the Wednesday, December 3, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Public Hearings

7A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-11, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  FLOOR ADDITION AND NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 13345 ASHWORTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7027-
  013-003).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Chair Reyes recused himself due to a conflict of interest. As Vice Chair, Jhaveri
  was absent. Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña facilitated the item in his
  stead.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing property
  conditions. Mr. Loh continued providing details about the proposed construction of a
  373-square-foot first-floor addition and a new 1,368-square-foot second floor to an
  existing single-story residence. Mr. Loh concluded his presentation by stating that no
  comments were received regarding the proposed project.
City of Cerritos  January 14, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   Discussion continued regarding the proposed installation of an elevator.

  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña opened the public hearing. Project
  applicant and homeowner Jeng Chang Wu provided comments regarding the size of
  the proposed home.

  Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Ao and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-1: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-11, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  FLOOR ADDITION AND NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY
  RESIDENCE AT 13345 ASHWORTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7027-
  013-003).*

  The motion carried (3-0-1-1) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  RECUSE:  Reyes

7B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND CHAPTER 22.46 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, RELATED TO
  LOCATION AND PERMITTING CRITERIA FOR BODY ART BUSINESSES.*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  Staff recommended that the item be tabled due to additional amendments to the
  Cerritos Municipal Code regarding body art businesses.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chauhan and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao to table the item for a future Planning Commission meeting.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO AMEND
  THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF
City of Cerritos  January 14, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   APPROXIMATELY ±0.44 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 18616 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE
  (APN: 7030-002-903), FROM LOW DENSITY TO PARKS AND OPEN SPACE.*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT MAP AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO AMEND
  THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±0.44 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED
  AT 18616 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE (APN: 7030-002-903), FROM SINGE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) TO OPEN SPACE (OS).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CITY COUNCIL
  APPROVE LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT 2026-1, A PROPOSAL BY THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  TO ADJUST EXISTING PROPERTY LINES BETWEEN TWO PARCELS WITHIN HERITAGE
  PARK, LOCATED AT 18600 AND 18616 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE (APNS 7030-002-901
  AND 7030-002-903). *

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) and Section 15305 of the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Mary Balderrama. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details on the existing land use and zoning
  designations, and lot lines for the property located at 18600 and 18616 Bloomfield
  Avenue. Ms. Balderrama continued by providing details about the proposed
  adjustments to the land use and zoning designations, the Los Angeles County
  Measure A funding available for the Heritage Park Island improvements, and the
  requirements associated with accessing the funds. Ms. Balderrama concluded her
  presentation by providing details of the proposed amendments General Plan
  Amendment (GPA 2026-1), Development Map Amendment (DMA 2026-1), and Lot
  Line Adjustment (LLA 2026-1).

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the City’s acquisition of former
  residential property, the previous land use, and the Commission's understanding of
  Senate Bill 330.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Surti and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-2: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS
  CITY COUNCIL APPROVE GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION
  OF APPROXIMATELY ±0.44 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 18616 BLOOMFIELD
  AVENUE (APN: 7030-002-903), FROM LOW DENSITY TO PARKS AND OPEN SPACE.*

  Resolution No. 2026-3: A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
  RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT MAP
  AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO AMEND THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF
  APPROXIMATELY ±0.44 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 18616 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE
  (APN: 7030-002-903), FROM SINGE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-6500) TO OPEN
  SPACE (OS).*

  RECOMMENDING THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT 2026-1,
  A PROPOSAL BY THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO ADJUST EXISTING PROPERTY LINES
  BETWEEN TWO PARCELS WITHIN HERITAGE PARK, LOCATED AT 18600 AND 18616
  BLOOMFIELD AVENUE (APNS 7030-002-901 AND 7030-002-903). *

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Planning
  Commission.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Ao, Commissioner Chauhan, Commissioner
  Surti, and Chair Reyes.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:15 p.m.
